name: OceanNex for DigitalOcean
tagline: Manage Your DigitalOcean Infrastructure with OceanNex
blurb: A powerful native Android app to control your DigitalOcean droplets, domains, managed databases, firewalls, volumes and more...
description:
A powerful native Android app to control your DigitalOcean droplets, domains, managed databases, firewalls, volumes and more...

Features

- Multiple accounts support
- Theme to blend with your system UI (dynamic colors)
- Biometric support for security
- Set your default home screen
- Change to your native language, if available
- Dashboard to view all important info
- Create and view droplets
- View all events
- View and create firewalls
- Manage domains with records
- Reboot, rebuild, delete, destroy, rename, reset password of droplet and more..
- Enable and manage droplet backups
- Manage droplet snapshots
- View regions, OS images and marketplace apps, plans and sizes
- View and create VPCs
- Manage and create your certificates
- Add and manage your uptime checks
- View, manage, add, delete managed cluster databases
- Add and remove users and databases for a database cluster
- View billing info, invoices and recent history
- Download invoices as PDF
- Create and manage your projects
- and many more...

Complete list of features: https://codeberg.org/swatian/OceanNex/wiki/Features

Source code: https://codeberg.org/swatian/OceanNex

Developer: https://mastodon.social/@mmarif
